speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: MND seeks to build an inclusive and endearing home, nurture cohesive communities and develop Singapore into a sustainable and thriving City in a Garden.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Homeownership is a key tenet of our social compact.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will ensure that our housing policies continue to help young couples start a family, uplift the lower-income and vulnerable to a better future and facilitate our seniors to age gracefully.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We have helped first-timer families own their first HDB home and increased the quota for second-time flat buyers where possible.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will help families live closer together so that they can better care for their parents and young children.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will provide a range of choices so that there is a home for every budget and need.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will press on with efforts to ensure that our housing programme remains inclusive.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will work closely with social agencies to support these families in a holistic manner; including helping them to find employment and keeping their children in school to ensure that they can sustain progress and homeownership.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: For others who have fallen on hard times and need shelter while they get back on their feet, we will build more public rental flats and integrate them within larger HDB estates.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will also look into ways to support other vulnerable groups, including divorcees and low-income singles.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We have also implemented the 2-Room Flexi Scheme to provide choice and flexibility for seniors looking to right-size to a smaller home.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will continue to build on such options to meet the housing and retirement needs of our seniors.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Our estates will continue to be accessible to all, including our seniors.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: New smart-enabled homes will empower residents to adopt solutions, such as the Smart Elderly Monitoring and Alert System, in their homes, so that seniors live in a safer and more conducive environment.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We have made new flats available to singles since 2013 to respond to changes in our society.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We have seen strong demand from singles and will continue to help singles own their homes.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Beyond individual homes, we aim to create more shared spaces to nurture a vibrant and cohesive community where neighbours come together to celebrate the Kampong Spirit.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will build more town plazas and neighbourhood centres with projects and activities to engage the community.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Heartland shops will be revitalised into vibrant commercial nodes and social spaces for community bonding through the Revitalisation of Shops Scheme.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will create spaces to meet community needs.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Childcare centres, elder care centres and other social communal facilities will be provided in Build-To-Order (BTO) projects.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will also explore co-locating and integrating some of these to encourage inter-generation bonding among families and neighbours.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Page: 46 We will partner all Singaporeans to improve our communities.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Through the Municipal Services Office's OneService Mobile App, residents can give feedback about municipal issues they face in their environment.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will continue to work with residents, grassroots organisations, civic groups and partner agencies to build an engaged community that cares and actively participates in improving our living environment.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Communities in Singapore will also be connected by an expanded network of green corridors, which will grow from 300 kilometres to 400 kilometres.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will activate green spaces and intensify greenery horizontally and vertically and work with passionate Singaporeans to conserve our biodiversity and celebrate our built heritage.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will develop a sustainable and thriving city, one that is highly productive with efficient use of resources and minimum wastage.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will continue to help our construction industry improve productivity.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will spur the adoption of cleaner, quieter, highly productive construction methods, foster collaboration across the construction value chain and continue to upgrade and upskill the construction workforce.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Industry clustering and development of shared facilities across all relevant sectors will be explored to reduce land demand and increase productivity.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will press on with our efforts to revitalise our older estates.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The Remaking Our Heartland programme will continue to inject new life into these towns through comprehensive makeovers.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: At the precinct and block level, our Neighbourhood Renewal Programme will enhance the living environment while ageing flats will be upgraded through the Home Improvement Programme.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will continue with our Selective En bloc Redevelopment Scheme in old estates where redevelopment is viable economically and where there are suitable sites to house residents together.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will bring jobs closer to home, reducing travelling time to work.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: This will better support the needs of our families and our ageing population.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will also foster a safe and convenient environment for everyone to walk and cycle in our towns.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will also make it easier for people to adopt greener practices in their buildings, for instance, through adopting smart systems that enable users to better manage their energy consumption.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We must also optimise the use of agricultural land.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will continue to build our future Singapore, with Singaporeans and for Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Through the ongoing Future of Us Conversation, we invite Singaporeans to imagine the future and share their vision for our nation.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Communities will be empowered to be more involved in enlivening public spaces and improving our greening efforts.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Page: 47 Singapore is our home, where we belong.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Together, we can build an inclusive home and a sustainable future for all Singaporeans.
